subject: Message from Lasclay: The Milkweed Company

messages.text: I would like to know which seeds to buy. I live near Cotati California. Thanks, Kathy

Hi Kathy,

Apologies for how long this took, that's really not okay on our end.

For Cotati (Sonoma County, zone 9b), all of our milkweed species will do well. That said, here are a few that tend to perform especially nicely in warmer California climates:

- Asclepias fascicularis (Narrowleaf milkweed), native to California, very well adapted to your region

- Asclepias speciosa (Showy milkweed), also native to the West Coast, beautiful large blooms

- Asclepias tuberosa (Butterfly milkweed), a classic, great for drier conditions

You can find all our seed options here: https://lasclay.com/en/products/milkweed-seeds

We also have pre-stratified seeds (already cold-treated and ready to plant right away): https://lasclay.com/products/graines-semences-asclepiade-stratifiees-froid

Feel free to ask if you have any other questions!
